summary: Reiner Wiehl (1929–2010) was a philosopher who taught John Taber. He held posts at the University of Hamburg from circa 1970 to 1977 and Heidelberg University from circa 1977 to 1997.
Reinhold Grünendahl is an Indologist. He held posts at the Free University of Berlin (attested 1983) and the Göttingen State and University Library (attested 2008).

Reinhold Klotz (1807–1870) was a linguist who studied at Leipzig University from circa 1826 to 1829. He later held a post at Leipzig University from circa 1832 to 1870, where he taught Friedrich Max Müller.

Reinhold Rost (1822–1896) was an Indologist and linguist who studied at the University of Jena (~1842–1847). He served at The King's School Canterbury, St Augustine's College, the Royal Asiatic Society, and as Librarian for the India Office and India Office Library.

Renate Syed (born 1953) is an Indologist. She earned her doctorate at Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (~1974–1982), supervised by Dieter Schlingloff and taught by Friedrich Wilhelm and Gritli von Mitterwallner.
Renda Zheng (born 1944) works in Buddhist studies. Zheng studied under traditional teachers Kaizhi, Shengfa, and Kaitong.

René Gothóni (born 1950) is a scholar of religious and Buddhist studies who studied at the University of Helsinki (~1970–1982). He held a post at Helsinki from circa 1983 to 2014, where he taught Ilkka Pyysiäinen.

Richard A. Hutch (born 1945) is a religious studies scholar educated at Gettysburg College, Yale Divinity School, and the University of Chicago. He taught Peter Fenner and held posts at Southern Illinois University (~1975–1978) and the University of Queensland (~1978–2010).
Richard B. Martin (1937–2004) was an Indologist and Tibetologist. He worked at the University of Virginia as a professor (attested 1983–1991) and as a South Asian bibliographer (attested 2003).

Richard Baker (born 1936) is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Harvard University (~1954–1958) and under Shunryu Suzuki in 1971, whom he succeeded. He taught Philip Whalen and Taigen Dan Leighton.
Richard Barron is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under traditional teachers Kalu Rinpoche, Dezhung Rinpoche Kunga Tenpai Nyima, and the 3rd Jamgön Kongtrul.
Richard Bowring (born 1947) is a scholar in Japanology and Buddhist studies. He was educated at Blundell's School from circa 1960 to 1965 and Downing College from circa 1965 to 1973.

Richard Carnac Temple (1850–1931) studied at Harrow School and Trinity Hall. A scholar of Indology, history, and archaeology, he served in the Bengal and Indian Staff Corps and was editor and proprietor of The Indian Antiquary.
Richard D. Mann is a scholar of Indology and religious studies. He completed a PhD at McMaster University (attested 2003) under the supervision of Phyllis Granoff.

Richard D. McBride II works in Buddhist studies, Sinology, and history and archaeology. He completed graduate studies under mentor Robert E. Buswell Jr. at UCLA, held a fellowship at Washington University in St. Louis, and worked at Dongguk University.

Richard F. Nance is a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and religious studies who completed his PhD at the University of Chicago in 2004. He taught Cameron Bailey and became an assistant professor at Indiana University (attested 2013).
Richard Fick (1867–1944) was an Indologist. He studied at the University of Kiel from circa 1885 to 1888 and later held a post at the University of Göttingen from circa 1921 to 1932.

Richard Foltz (born 1961) is a scholar of Iranian and Central Asian studies, religious studies, and history/archaeology. Educated at the University of Utah and Harvard University, he held posts at the University of Florida and Concordia University.
Richard Fritzsche (born 1851) was an Indologist who studied under Hermann Brockhaus. He held the post of Rektor at Gymnasium Schneeberg.

Richard Gombrich (born 1937) is a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar. He earned a D.Phil. at Oxford under Robert Charles Zaehner, having also studied under Gananath Obeyesekere and Walpola Rahula, and served as Boden Professor at Oxford and Balliol College.
